ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) dominate approximately 85-90% of the surface area, with high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) localized at the distal tips and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The central fluke body is a contiguous low-intensity region. High-intensity mottling is mapped to the distal ends of both lobes. The right lobe distal region contains a primary white cluster with internal low-intensity focal points. The left lobe distal region shows smaller, diffuse white streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct V-shaped central notch is visible with an approximate interior angle of 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations are present along the entire trailing edge. The amplitude of these variations increases significantly towards the tips, characterized by sharp peaks and deep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a macro-scale convex sweep from the median notch, terminating in an upward-curving distal tip on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible on the distal white patch of the right lobe as dark, roughly circular pixel clusters; similar smaller clusters are detectable on the left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear disruptions are visible in the pigmentation of the left lobe, mid-upper region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular tissue loss and jagged 'fringing' at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting significant wear or past bio-fouling damage.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe contains a distinctive high-contrast white focal patch situated on the trailing edge margin, roughly three-quarters of the way from the notch to the tip.
